items.title: Yen Caught Between Top U.S. Officials’ Remarks
items.summary: Yen Caught Between Top U.S. Officials’ Remarks    WSJ

evidence.event_kind: speculation on monetary policy and exchange rate intervention

context.event_kind: speculation on monetary policy and exchange rate intervention
context.coverage_check: While the model includes interest rate differentials via d2Y_DIFF and d10Y_DIFF, it has no factor to represent qualitative policy remarks, speculative flow, or unconfirmed intervention rumors.
context.continuity_check: The reporting describes a new episode of market speculation and official comments, which is unrelated to the actual direct intervention operations reported 24 trading days ago on 2026-08-03.

why_unexplained.en: The model assigned -18.6 bp to systematic factors and -1.6 bp to exogenous factors, leaving an unexplained residual of -151.3 bp. This residual represents a z-score of -4.14, far exceeding the median |residual| of 12.2 bp in the recent window and 20.0 bp over one year. While the model contains rate differentials via d2Y_DIFF and d10Y_DIFF, it does not have a factor to carry qualitative official remarks or dismissed intervention rumors, which represents a structural limitation of the model on this day.
why_unexplained.zh: 模型将 -18.6 bp 归入系统性因素，将 -1.6 bp 归入外生因素，留下 -151.3 bp 的未解释残差。该残差的 z-score 为 -4.14，远超近期窗口 12.2 bp 的中位数绝对残差和一年窗口的 20.0 bp。尽管模型通过 d2Y_DIFF 和 d10Y_DIFF 包含了利差因素，但其缺乏承载官方口头表态或被否认的干预传言的因子，这构成了模型在今日的结构性局限。

evidence.event_kind: direct operation in the currency market

context.event_kind: direct operation in the currency market
context.coverage_check: No factor in the model, which comprises systematic dollar and carry factors alongside interest rate differentials, equity volatility, and gold, is designed to capture direct central bank interventions in the currency market.
context.continuity_check: The reporting describes follow-on coverage of the currency market interventions that began around the previous flagged day on 2026-07-31, one trading day prior, with the market moves still working through.

why_unexplained.en: The USDJPY pair fell by -163.7 bp, with the model assigning -12.4 bp to systematic factors and +5.5 bp to exogenous factors. This leaves an unexplained residual of -156.8 bp, which represents a highly unusual move with a residual z-score of -4.17. This leftover far exceeds the median unexplained move of 104.2 bp on flagged days, as well as the recent median residual of 20.5 bp and the one-year median of 20.2 bp. Direct currency intervention is not represented in the model's factor set, which spans DOLLAR_LOO, CARRY_LOO, d2Y_DIFF, d10Y_DIFF, dVIX, and GOLD.
why_unexplained.zh: USDJPY货币对下跌了-163.7 bp，其中模型将-12.4 bp分配给系统性因素，将+5.5 bp分配给外生性因素。这留下了-156.8 bp的未解释残差，对应残差z分数为-4.17。这一未解释部分远超被标记交易日104.2 bp的未解释幅度的中位数，也远超近期20.5 bp和一年期20.2 bp的残差中位数。直接货币干预并未包含在该模型的因子集中，该因子集包括DOLLAR_LOO、CARRY_LOO、d2Y_DIFF、d10Y_DIFF、dVIX和GOLD。
